== Course of events ==

Having been brought before Glinda, who sits upon a throne of rubies, Dorothy recounts her whole story and tells her that her greatest wish is to return to Kansas to Aunt Em and Uncle Henry. Glinda agrees to help her, but asks for the Golden Cap in exchange, and Dorothy willingly gives it up.

The exchange resolves cleanly: Dorothy parts with the Golden Cap without hesitation, and Glinda accepts it as payment for her aid. With the Cap now hers, Glinda is able to use its three remaining commands to send the Winged Monkeys to carry the Scarecrow to the Emerald City, the Tin Woodman to the Winkies, and the Lion to his own forest, while also explaining to Dorothy how the Silver Shoes can carry their wearer anywhere in three steps.
